marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic marker is the catalog-driven REVOKE EXECUTE loop over trigger-returning functions. No sidecar check kind can assert role privileges: the supported kinds are exact_row_count, catalog_contract and catalog_absence, none of which expresses has_function_privilege state. The durable proof is the in-migration census assertion (the same DO block raises if any in-scope anon/authenticated EXECUTE grant survives) plus the preview after-census and issue #6415's acceptance check.
